caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Burns International Security Services, Inc.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Burns International Security Services, Inc. (formerly known as William J. Burns International Detective Agency, Inc.) and Burns International Security Services, Inc. v. National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 822.] Motion of respondent International Union, United Plant Guard Workers of America, for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 minutes allotted to the Union for that purpose. Burns International Security Services, Inc., allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
